Package com.egradx.notification.auth

Class EgradxNotificationAuthAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.notification.auth.EgradxNotificationAuthAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfiguration(after=EgradxAuthAutoConfiguration.class, before=EgradxNotificationAutoConfiguration.class) public class EgradxNotificationAuthAutoConfiguration extends Object
Wires egradx-notification and egradx-auth to each other:
  • the inbox knows who is signed in, and since when they have been a member;
  • a message to a user goes to their verified address on the channel, in their language;
  • egradx-auth can send the codes that verify those addresses;
  • a bulk send reaches every active member of an organization, or every active user;
  • the admin endpoints know the caller and their authorities, and those authorities live in egradx-auth's catalog — broadcast reserved to the platform organization.
Ordered before egradx-notification's own configuration, so that these are registered before its fallbacks check whether one exists.
